text.content:
Downtown's private police, and the last of them.

Headquarters: The Bridgehead, Downtown (built 2051; Danger Gal's since 2070)
Industry: Private district security (defunct)
Status: Lost its last contract when the NCPD took Downtown in 2069

In the 2040s, private firms policed much of Night City district by district: Scythe, SK Securities, Los Perros Guardianes and others. After the Purge, MaxTac rejoined the NCPD and the NCPD became the city's one legal enforcement agency, and over the next years the private providers lost their contracts one by one. Whitewater Security in Downtown held out longest, until 2069.

It built its headquarters in 2051 to be held: eighteen floors of poured concrete at the foot of the Coronado Bay Bridge, with holding cells, an armory, a firing range, vehicle bays and an AV pad. Danger Gal bought it in 2070. People in Downtown who remember Whitewater miss it, which says something about the NCPD's stop-and-frisk patrols. Ex-Whitewater sergeant Pieter "Brick" Van Aart still runs a neighborhood watch in Little Europe that the NCPD hates.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 05, 07
